messages:
mira: Quick RFC follow-up: proposal to terminate TLS in a tiny tenant-side proxy and instead send a short-lived signed JWT to CP with claims (tenant, endpoint, sni, nonce, iat). Goal: avoid peering and keep client src IP in tenant logs while reducing CP mTLS load. Thoughts?

jon: Important: revocation mid-session. nonce+jti with in-memory revocation window at CP? ok but needs scale tests.

srini: how do we bootstrap trust for proxies? suggest short-lived client certs from bootstrap flow (rotate hourly). Also want auditable mapping cert_fp -> subject.

kate: operations: customers often block outbound egress. doc needs exact outbound IPs, DNS records, and a sample iptables rule. Also list fallback: TCP passthrough for E2E TLS customers.

deploy-bot: Canary created: sni-jwt-proxy.canary -> tenants: canary-a, canary-b.

infra: perf note: signing ~0.6ms, verify ~1ms at 5k rps in our prototype. Add metrics: jwt_verify_p50/95/99, token_issue_rate, token_revocations.

mira: next steps: I9ll write the short design doc (sequence diagram + claim list + TTL policy) and a small prototype. Jon will own benchmark harness; Srini will spike attestation/rotation. Kate will draft the customer runbook. Posting PR by EOD tomorrow.

jon: +1. we should also record websocket keepalive requirements in doc.

srini: +1. will add attestation notes.

kate: +1. will prep runbook template.
